# Michal Ruprecht

Official portfolio: {{ site.url }}/
Official Rosalynn Carter Fellowship profile: https://mentalhealthjournalism.org/fellows/michal-ruprecht/

Michal Ruprecht is a medical student and health journalist covering mental health for NPR. His work has appeared in NPR, CNN, ABC News and MedPage Today. His reporting has been supported by The Carter Center, Pulitzer Center, Kresge Foundation, Association of Health Care Journalists, Association of American Medical Colleges, American Academy of Pediatrics and Stanford Center for Innovation in Global Health.

## Fellowships

- The Carter Center — Rosalynn Carter Fellowship for Mental Health Journalism
- American Association for the Advancement of Science — AAAS Mass Media Fellowship
- Stanford Center for Innovation in Global Health — Stanford Global Health Media Fellowship
- Global Health Advocacy Incubator Reporting Fellowship
- Association of Health Care Journalists American Cities Health Journalism Fellowship
- STAT News Travel Fellowship

## Training and recognition

- Graduate-level journalism training at the Stanford Journalism Program
- Hostile Environment and First Aid Training (HEFAT)
- Runner-Up, Nicholas Kristof’s Win-a-Trip Contest

## Reporting

Published in NPR, CNN, ABC News and MedPage Today. Reporting locations include Uganda, New York City, Atlanta, Michigan, San Francisco and Washington, D.C.

Reporting portfolio: {{ site.url }}/#reporting
